summary: Dacoity conviction challenge; dock identification by sole witness (PW-9) unreliable without corroboration; TIP not substantive evidence; non-examination of key witnesses (driver, conductor, khalasi) undermines prosecution; no recovery of looted items; arrest with country-made pistol lacks forensic linkage; prosecution case fails to inspire confidence; conviction based on insufficient evidence.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellant acquitted.
